site.name: WW2 Film Map
site.tagline: Every war film, on the ground where it happened
site.description: Explore {count} World War II, World War I and interwar films and series on an interactive 3D globe: see where each story happened, follow its journey across the map, learn the real history and find where to watch it.

map.title: World War II films on a 3D globe
map.intro: Spin the globe, scrub through time from 1914 to 1945 and open any film to follow its story across the places where it really happened.
map.webglFallback: Your browser can't show the 3D globe, but every film is listed below.
map.hint: Drag to rotate · scroll or pinch to zoom · drag the date to travel in time

watch.none: Not available to stream in {region} right now.

films.title: World War II films and series
films.intro: {count} films and series about World War II, World War I and the years between them, each mapped to the places where it happened.
films.goldIntro: The films every war-cinema fan should see at least once.

ww1.title: Best World War I movies and series
ww1.intro: From the trenches of the Somme to the deserts of Arabia: the films that bring the Great War of 1914–1918 to life, mapped to where they happened.

interwar.title: Films about the interwar years (1918–1939)
interwar.intro: Revolutions, civil wars and the rise of fascism: the films that tell how the world walked from one world war into the next.

ww2.title: Best World War II movies and series
ww2.intro: From Dunkirk to Iwo Jima: the essential films and series about the Second World War, mapped to the places where their stories unfold.

places.title: World War II places in film
places.intro: The cities, beaches, camps and battlefields that appear in more than one war film. Pick a place to see every story set there.

timeline.title: World War II timeline 1914–1945
timeline.intro: Thirty-one years that changed the world, from the shot in Sarajevo to the surrender in Tokyo Bay, with the films that tell each chapter.

about.title: About the project
about.intro: WW2 Film Map started as a personal list of the war films I had watched. It grew into a 3D atlas of war cinema: pick a film, see where it happened, learn what really happened there, and find where to watch it.
about.step1Text: Drag the timeline from 1914 to 1945 and watch borders, fronts, tanks, ships and planes move across the globe.
about.step2Text: Every poster sits where its story happens. Open one to follow its journey stop by stop.
about.step3Text: Read the real history behind the story, watch the trailer and see where it streams in your country.
about.sourcesText: Film data, posters, trailers and streaming availability come from TMDB and JustWatch. Historical borders come from the historical-basemaps project; history and places are researched from Wikipedia and Wikidata.
about.tmdbNotice: This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.
